title: Impact Assessment
cross_references: EM Knowledge for the Impact Assessment Guidelines

nodes.text: Initiate and manage Initial Impact Assessment (IIA)

evidence.source_text: The incident controller is responsible for initiating and managing an initial impact assessment (IIA) and authorising the release of collected information.
The incident controller is responsible for initiating and managing an initial impact assessment (IIA) and authorising the release of collected information.

nodes.text: Determine requirement for Initial Impact Assessment (IIA)

evidence.source_text: Triggers to determine the requirement for IIA should be considered in accordance with the state strategic control priorities.

nodes.text: Consider triggers for IIA: injured/deceased persons, residential damage, damage to infrastructure, community facilities, primary production impact

evidence.source_text: Some practical examples include: injured/deceased persons, residential damage, damage to essential infrastructure, damage to facilities of community significance, identification of primary production impact.

nodes.text: Manage IIA process with flexibility and adapt to circumstances

evidence.source_text: IIA arrangements are designed to allow for flexibility in their application as it often occur in a dynamic environment.

nodes.text: Make IIA information available to IEMT and recovery role

evidence.source_text: Information collected in the IIA stage will be progressively made available to the IEMT and nominated recovery role.
Dependent on the scale and complexity of the event the Incident Controller may:

nodes.text: Use existing IMT and field resources

evidence.source_text: choose to use existing IMT and field based resources

nodes.text: Establish specific functional unit within IMT/IEMT for IIA

evidence.source_text: establish a specific functional unit within the IMT/IEMT to support the IIA process.
request additional resource/s to assist in conducting and managing IIA

nodes.text: Request establishment of regional team if required

evidence.source_text: request the establishment of a regional team, where required.

nodes.text: Facilitate transition from IIA to Secondary Impact Assessment (SIA)

evidence.source_text: The Incident Controller is required to facilitate the transition from IIA to SIA.

nodes.text: Ensure impacted area is safe for non-responder personnel for SIA

evidence.source_text: For SIA to commence, the Incident Controller needs to be satisfied the impacted area is safe for non-responder personnel to operate in.

nodes.text: Coordinate SIA with nominated recovery role

evidence.source_text: Coordination of SIA is the responsibility of the nominated recovery role.
